name: NavigationAction
description: Represents a single navigation or interaction step executed inside a programmable browser session.

action.description: Type of action performed against the browser session.

session_id.description: Identifier of the browser session this action is dispatched against.

url.description: Target URL when the action is a navigation.

selector.description: CSS, XPath, or accessibility selector used by the action.

value.description: Value supplied for type, select, or evaluate actions.

wait_until.description: Page lifecycle event to wait for before the action is considered complete.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds the action may take before failing.

capture.description: Optional artifact capture configuration for the action.

status.description: Outcome of the action after execution.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the action in milliseconds.
